runs.name: Kaiser Group Holdings, Inc.; Pink Sheets KGHI, SEC CIK 0000856200, successor issuer to Kaiser Group International, Inc., formerly ICF Kaiser International, Inc., reorganized under Chapter 11 effective 2000-12-18; at its last 10-K (FY2006) a holding company with half of Kaiser-Hill Company, LLC (the DOE Rocky Flats closure contractor, in a non-fee-bearing closeout), the Nova Hut claims and a captive insurer in run-off; odd-lot tender at $29.80 closed January 2008, Form 15 filed 2008-02-28
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$0.0001**, "No trades" (TradingView, read 2026-10-17, aggregator, flagged, no date of last trade; OTC Markets' quote pages under maintenance, its record showing tier code "EM" and zero financial reports posted); recorded, not usable. Shares: no current cover page; **1,320,155** at 2012-09-30 (1,791,577 issued less 471,422 treasury), the company's own unaudited statements of that date, the latest the record holds; `Screens/cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` both returned not an SEC filer. Cap about $132 on those figures, recorded, not used. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-16). Filings read: 10-K FY2006 (`0001104659-07-024333`), 10-K FY2005 (`0001104659-06-019740`), 10-K/A FY2006, 10-Q 2007-09-30 (`0001104659-07-082552`), DEF 14A 2007-09-26 (`0001104659-07-071331`), SC 13E3 and amendment, the 8-Ks of 2007-11 to 2008-02, Form 15 of 2008-02-28 (`0001104659-08-013837`). The brief's third stated departure (no SEC filing since 2008): the company's own statements to stockholders from 2008-03-31 to **2012-09-30**, read from Internet Archive captures of www.kaisergroup.com, recorded by document and date; the audited annuals for 2007 to 2010 posted as scanned images and not read (their year-ends read from the next interim's prior-year column); the company's 2015 document list names annual statements through 2014, a 2015 meeting document and a "Kaiser Announcement", none ever captured; the site dead from 2016 and the domain now an unrelated German company; OTC Markets carries no report. Cross-check: equity $66,117 thousand at 2006-12-31 in both the FY2006 balance sheet and its Item 6. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst (eight, listed in the run file). Rivals: the FY2006 10-K names none; none read. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)** **[M2008-069]**, **[M2006-076]**, **[M2002-092]**, **[M2006-013]**: what the company owns and earns today cannot be known from any document an outsider can get, and the largest part in the last report, a cost-carried 19.38% stake in Bally Total Fitness (private; $22.7M paid, written down $11.3M), could not be read from it either; no part had an operating profit in any year read. The cause is a **CONVENTION of the run**: an issuer silent for more than a decade sent to NATURE, not WORK, because the work was done and the cure lies with the issuer; re-look condition: audited statements for a fiscal year after 2012, or a new SEC registration. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the 2007 odd-lot tender at $29.80 (6,313 shares) to get below 300 holders and deregister, book then about $36.51 a share; buybacks after going dark of about 470,000 shares at about $27 to $30 while book was about $36 to $37, from holders no longer receiving SEC reports; $15.0M committed to Tennenbaum Opportunities Fund VI, managed by an entity where a director is a senior managing partner, half the commitment later bought from the company by a director with fees waived for him; FY2006 pay of $579,783 to the chief executive and $452,926 to the chief financial officer in a year the 10-K says had "no active operations"; a 2011 aircraft maintenance unit losing money in every period read. Balance sheets 2005 to 2012-09-30 (eight year-ends and the last interim, 2004 in three lines): one contract collected and then spent, the Rocky Flats fee paying a $6.00 dividend in 2006, equity $79.1M (2005) to $19.8M (2012-09-30), non-marketable investments at cost two thirds of assets by 2012. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: **no value range and no fair price**, none computable (no owner-cash figure for any year after 2012); operations lost money in every documented year from 2004; cash used in operations $6.5M in the first nine months of 2012; book about $14.98 a share at 2012-09-30, a figure fourteen years old, not a value; not armed. No research pass (NATURE). Contamination declared by the analyst: one filtered listing of `Test Runs/` for "KGHI" or "kaiser" before the file was written, returning nothing; the session's commit subjects, the lock file name and memory index lines; a v4 verdict word printed by `tools/run.py`; none used. Commits 86ac1fc8 (Step 0, balance sheets, foundations), eaddc90f (Q1 and close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` PASS; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_verify.py`, 29 fragments within 300 characters before an id, 4 flags each read and found to be a tool output, a filing quote, a reading word or a neighbouring row's quotation inside the window, **no slip**, no E-ids. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the issuer that has gone silent fits neither WORK nor NATURE as section I defines them, sent to NATURE by a CONVENTION of the run, a named rule or a third cause asked for; (2) a document the company listed but no outsider can now retrieve, against one never published; (3) the template's Q7 line has no place for "not computable", and the alert needs a rule for a name with no tradeable price and no figures. Could not get: the 2011 to 2014 annual statements and anything after; the 2007 to 2010 audited annuals in readable form; a live OTC Markets quote.
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 (Kaiser Group Holdings, Pink Sheets KGHI, successor to ICF Kaiser International after the Chapter 11 of 2000; deregistered from the SEC in 2008 after an odd-lot tender at $29.80; the company's last retrievable report is its unaudited statements of 2012-09-30, its website gone since 2016 and its domain now an unrelated company, OTC Markets carrying no report; the largest part then a cost-carried 19.38% stake in private Bally Total Fitness; the cause NATURE by a CONVENTION of the run, re-look on audited statements after 2012 or a new registration. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: buybacks below book after going dark, a director's fund dealings, FY2006 pay with no operations. No value range and no fair price computable; quote $0.0001 with no trades, not usable; not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: the silent issuer between WORK and NATURE, a listed but unretrievable document, Q7 and the alert with no figures.)
